Do you need to pick the largest iPhone Pro to get the best camera features? The situation is different with each generation. Although so far, most reports have indicated that the camera specifications of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max should be no different, a leaker has raised some doubts about this claim today.

He specifically mentioned that two new features expected to appear on both Pro models "may" become exclusive to the Pro Max first……

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max have identical camera specifications, with all three rear lenses being 48-megapixel sensors. Apple says the telephoto lens can achieve 8x optical zoom, but it actually does so by cropping a 24-megapixel image, so the more accurate statement is that it has 4x optical zoom, plus the ability to crop images to 8x.

So far, we have (broadly) expected this year's Pro models to keep their camera specifications consistent, with both models featuring a variable aperture main lens and a telephoto lens with a larger aperture, the latter of which can perform better in low-light environments.

However, leaker Ice Universe has said that two new telephoto lens features may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

If this claim is true, it means that if you want the longest focal length for the telephoto lens and the best performance in low-light environments, you will have to buy the Pro Max model. However, he used the word "may", indicating that he himself is not very certain, and may have seen conflicting evidence from different parts of the supply chain.

Previously, some have also mentioned that the variable aperture system on the main lens may be exclusive to the Pro Max, but reports on this front have also been contradictory.

If you usually prefer the smaller of the two Pro models, but this time the larger Pro Max has stronger camera features, would you switch to the Pro Max for these upgrades? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
